newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine satellite firm gets $11 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: Philippine satellite firm gets $11 mln bank loan.

text.p: Philippine Agila Satellite Inc (PASI), a joint venture of several telecommunications firms, has received a $11 million loan from a syndicate of South Korean and Philippine banks, one of its joint owners said on Thursday.
"This is just the start of loan facilities being arranged to fund the requirements of PASI's satellite projects for the next two years," Domsat Holdings Inc said in a statement.
PASI plans to launch an interim satellite to serve its clients for the next two years, when its main satellite, currently being manufactured by France's Aerospatiale, is scheduled to be launched.

The three South Korean banks in the loan syndicate included First Merchant Banking Corp, Industrial Bank of Korea and Tong Yang Merchant Bank. The other banks included Land Bank of the Philippines and Westmont Bank.

Other partners in PASI include Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc, Pilipino Telephone Corp and Smart Communications Inc, the phone unit of Metro Pacific Corp. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
